microgravity_tips: DRAFT: Restrain the patient against a firm surface (straps or the crew medical restraint) so they do not float away from you.
DRAFT: Brace yourself so your pushes go into the chest. Published microgravity CPR methods: the Evetts-Russomano position and the handstand position. Yenna adds how to do each.
DRAFT: Swap rescuers when the timer says so. Compressions are tiring without gravity.
